description: This file defines the AsyncHelper class with static methods to facilitate running tasks on the UI thread, delaying execution, and waiting for task completion within a Windows environment, primarily for use in unit tests within the CalculatorApp project.

classes.name: AsyncHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to run asynchronous tasks on the UI thread, delay execution, and wait for task completion, tailored for Windows Runtime environment in the CalculatorApp project.

methods.name: RunOnUIThreadAsync
methods.description: Executes a given action asynchronously on the UI thread, returning a task representing the operation.

methods.name: RunOnUIThread
methods.description: Runs a given action synchronously on the UI thread with an optional timeout.

methods.name: Delay
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: RunOnUIThread (template)
methods.description: Runs an asynchronous task on the UI thread and waits for its completion within a specified timeout.

methods.name: WaitForTask
methods.description: Waits for a given task to complete within a specified timeout, handling exceptions and synchronization.

methods.name: Sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of milliseconds (private method).
